rationale: A unanimous, text-and-structure holding that § 924(c)(1)(D)(ii) applies only to terms imposed “under” subsection (c), leaving § 924(j) sentences governed by § 3584(a) discretion, is likely to be assigned by the Chief to himself or a consensus stylist (Kagan/Kavanaugh). Separate writings are most likely from Gorsuch (lenity/anti-expansion), Alito (anti-circumvention), or Thomas (formal drafting/hierarchy), with others less likely given the narrow, minimalist resolution.
